premise: Nico teases Turtle for crawling so slowly on the sand; she challenges him to a race in the sea and swims past him like a bird through the sky.
inspiration: Aesop's tortoise and hare, turned inside out: the slow one is fast in her own place, and the teasing ends in admiration.
learning: Sea turtles are slow on the sand but swift in the water.

en-US.title: Slow on Sand, Fast in Sea
en-US.text: {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Turtle was crawling across the sand. Flip… flop… ever so slowly. {surfer:enter} Nico came by with his yellow board. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [playfully] "Turtle, you're SO slow!" {turtle:live peek} Turtle tucked her head in, and peeked out again, smiling. {turtle:live talk} [playfully] On land, I'm slow, she said. But in the water? Race you! {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] "You're on!" {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelican landed on the rocks to watch. {pelican:pulse} Ready, steady… GO! {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Nico paddled out as fast as he could. {turtle:go to sea by swim} Turtle slid into the water and WHOOSH! She flew through the waves like a bird through the sky. {pelican:live scoop} Pelican was so amazed he scooped up a beakful of water. [laughs] {turtle:go to shore} By the time Nico rode a wave {surfer:go to sand by surf} back in, Turtle was already waiting. {turtle:hearts} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live laugh} {surfer:says} [laughs] "Okay, Turtle. You're the fastest swimmer here!" {surfer:hop}

es-ES.title: Lenta en tierra, rápida nadando
es-ES.text: {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tortuga cruzaba la arena arrastrándose. Flip… flop… despacito, despacito. {surfer:enter} Nico pasó con su tabla amarilla. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [playfully] «¡Tortuga, qué LENTA eres!» {turtle:live peek} Tortuga escondió la cabeza y la volvió a asomar, sonriendo. {turtle:live talk} [playfully] En tierra soy lenta, dijo. ¿Pero en el agua? ¡Te echo una carrera! {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] «¡Vale!» {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelícano se posó en las rocas para mirar. {pelican:pulse} Preparados, listos… ¡YA! {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Nico remó tan rápido como pudo. {turtle:go to sea by swim} Tortuga se deslizó en el agua y ¡FIUUU! Volaba entre las olas como un pájaro por el cielo. {pelican:live scoop} Pelícano se quedó tan asombrado que recogió un buen trago de agua. [laughs] {turtle:go to shore} Cuando Nico volvió cogiendo una ola {surfer:go to sand by surf} hasta la arena, Tortuga ya lo estaba esperando. {turtle:hearts} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live laugh} {surfer:says} [laughs] «Vale, Tortuga. ¡Eres la que nada más rápido de aquí!» {surfer:hop}

ja-JP.title: おそくて はやい ウミガメさん
ja-JP.text: {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to sand}ウミガメさんが、砂の上をはっていました。ぺたん…ぺたん…ゆっくり、ゆっくり。{surfer:enter}ニコが、きいろいボードをもって、とおりかかりました。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[playfully]「ウミガメさん、すっごくおそいね！」 {turtle:live peek}ウミガメさんは、くびをひっこめて…また出して、にっこり。{turtle:live talk}[playfully]「りくでは、おそいの。でも、水のなかなら？きょうそうしましょ！」 {surfer:face surprised}{surfer:says}[excited]「よーし、しょうぶだ！」 {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}ペリカンくんが、岩にとまって見物です。{pelican:pulse}よーい…ドン！{surfer:go to sea by paddle}ニコは、ちからいっぱいこいでいきます。{turtle:go to sea by swim}ウミガメさんは、するりと水に入って…びゅーん！まるで、空をとぶとりみたいに、波のなかをすすんでいきます。{pelican:live scoop}ペリカンくんは、びっくりして、おもわず水をすくっちゃった。[laughs]{turtle:go to shore}ニコが、ボードで{surfer:go to sand by surf}すいーっともどってきたときには、ウミガメさんは、もうまっていました。{turtle:hearts}{surfer:face happy}{surfer:live laugh}{surfer:says}[laughs]「まいった！およぐのは、ウミガメさんがいちばんだね！」 {surfer:hop}

de-DE.title: An Land langsam, im Meer schnell
de-DE.text: {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Die Meeresschildkröte kroch über den Sand. Flipp… flopp… ganz, ganz langsam. {surfer:enter} Nico kam mit seinem gelben Brett vorbei. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [playfully] „Schildkröte, du bist ja SO langsam!“ {turtle:live peek} Die Schildkröte zog den Kopf ein und streckte ihn lächelnd wieder heraus. {turtle:live talk} [playfully] „An Land bin ich langsam“, sagte sie. „Aber im Wasser? Wetten, dass ich schneller bin?“ {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] „Abgemacht!“ {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Der Pelikan landete auf den Felsen, um zuzuschauen. {pelican:pulse} Auf die Plätze, fertig… LOS! {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Nico paddelte hinaus, so schnell er konnte. {turtle:go to sea by swim} Die Schildkröte glitt ins Wasser und WUSCH! Sie flog durch die Wellen wie ein Vogel durch die Luft. {pelican:live scoop} Der Pelikan staunte so sehr, dass er einen Schnabel voll Wasser schöpfte. [laughs] {turtle:go to shore} Als Nico auf einer Welle {surfer:go to sand by surf} zurückgesurft kam, wartete die Schildkröte schon auf ihn. {turtle:hearts} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live laugh} {surfer:says} [laughs] „Okay, Schildkröte. Du bist hier die schnellste Schwimmerin!“ {surfer:hop}

fr-FR.title: Lente sur le sable, rapide dans l’eau
fr-FR.text: {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tortue de mer traversait la plage. Flip… flop… tout doucement, tout doucement. {surfer:enter} Nico est passé avec sa planche jaune. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [playfully] « Tortue, qu’est-ce que tu es LENTE ! » {turtle:live peek} Tortue a rentré la tête, puis elle l’a ressortie, en souriant. {turtle:live talk} [playfully] « Sur la terre, je suis lente, a-t-elle dit. Mais dans l’eau ? On fait la course ! » {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] « Chiche ! » {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pélican s’est posé sur les rochers pour regarder. {pelican:pulse} À vos marques, prêts… PARTEZ ! {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Nico a ramé de toutes ses forces vers le large. {turtle:go to sea by swim} Tortue s’est glissée dans l’eau, et FIOUUU ! Elle filait entre les vagues comme un oiseau dans le ciel. {pelican:live scoop} Pélican était si étonné qu’il a pris une grosse becquée d’eau. [laughs] {turtle:go to shore} Quand Nico a pris une vague {surfer:go to sand by surf} pour rentrer, Tortue l’attendait déjà. {turtle:hearts} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live laugh} {surfer:says} [laughs] « D’accord, Tortue. C’est toi qui nages le plus vite, ici ! » {surfer:hop}

it-IT.title: Lenta in spiaggia, veloce in mare
it-IT.text: {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tartaruga marina attraversava la sabbia, strisciando. Un passettino… un altro passettino… piano, piano, pianissimo. {surfer:enter} Nico è passato di lì con la sua tavola gialla. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [playfully] «Tartaruga, quanto sei LENTA!» {turtle:live peek} Tartaruga ha ritirato la testa, poi l'ha tirata fuori di nuovo, sorridendo. {turtle:live talk} [playfully] «Sulla terra sono lenta», ha detto. «Ma nell'acqua? Facciamo una gara!» {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] «Ci sto!» {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pellicano si è posato sugli scogli, per guardare. {pelican:pulse} Pronti, partenza… VIA! {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Nico ha remato al largo più veloce che poteva. {turtle:go to sea by swim} Tartaruga è scivolata in acqua e VUUUSH! Volava tra le onde come un uccello nel cielo. {pelican:live scoop} Pellicano era così stupito che ha raccolto un bel sorso d'acqua col becco. [laughs] {turtle:go to shore} Quando Nico è tornato cavalcando un'onda {surfer:go to sand by surf} fino a terra, Tartaruga lo stava già aspettando. {turtle:hearts} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live laugh} {surfer:says} [laughs] «Hai vinto tu, Tartaruga. Sei la più veloce a nuotare!» {surfer:hop}

zh-TW.title: 沙上慢，海裡快
zh-TW.text: {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to sand}海龜在沙灘上慢慢地爬。啪噠……啪噠……好慢、好慢。{surfer:enter}尼可抱著黃色衝浪板走過來。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[playfully]「海龜，你好慢喔！」 {turtle:live peek}海龜把頭縮進去，又探出來，笑咪咪的。{turtle:live talk}[playfully]「在陸地上，我是很慢，」 牠說，「可是在水裡呢？我們來比賽！」 {surfer:face surprised}{surfer:says}[excited]「好啊，比就比！」 {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}鵜鶘飛到岩石上，等著看。{pelican:pulse}預備——開始！{surfer:go to sea by paddle}尼可用最快的速度往外划。{turtle:go to sea by swim}海龜滑進水裡，咻——！牠在浪裡飛快地游，就像小鳥在天上飛。{pelican:live scoop}鵜鶘看得目瞪口呆，一不小心，舀了滿滿一嘴的水。[laughs]{turtle:go to shore}等尼可乘著一道浪{surfer:go to sand by surf}滑回來，海龜早就在那裡等他了。{turtle:hearts}{surfer:face happy}{surfer:live laugh}{surfer:says}[laughs]「好啦好啦，海龜！你是這裡游得最快的！」 {surfer:hop}

zh-HK.text: {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to sand}海龜在沙灘上慢慢地爬。啪……噠……慢吞吞，慢吞吞。{surfer:enter}尼可抱着黃色的滑浪板走過來。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[playfully]「海龜，你好——慢呀！」 {turtle:live peek}海龜把頭縮進殼裏，又探出來，笑眯眯的。{turtle:live talk}[playfully]「喺陸地上，我係慢，」 牠說，「但係喺水入面呢？我哋鬥快吖！」 {surfer:face surprised}{surfer:says}[excited]「嚟就嚟！」 {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}鵜鶘飛到岩石上，準備看比賽。{pelican:pulse}預備……起！{surfer:go to sea by paddle}尼可用盡全力往外划。{turtle:go to sea by swim}海龜一滑進水裏——嗖！就在浪裏飛快地穿梭，好像小鳥在天上飛。{pelican:live scoop}鵜鶘看呆了，一不小心舀了一大口水。[laughs]{turtle:go to shore}尼可乘着浪{surfer:go to sand by surf}滑回來的時候，海龜早就在等他了。{turtle:hearts}{surfer:face happy}{surfer:live laugh}{surfer:says}[laughs]「好啦，海龜，你係呢度游水游得最快嘅！」 {surfer:hop}
